metadata.description: Plugins and mods that make Claude Code better: work with the local Codex CLI, watch the prompt cache, preview pasted images, queue prompts without steering.

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Work with the local Codex CLI from Claude Code: codex-consult for adversarial design review in a read-only sandbox, codex-delegate for sandboxed implementation that keeps .git read-only.

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter above the prompt: the hit rate and the prompt as read + wrote + new, a live countdown to expiry, named misses, and when to /compact or /clear. Slash commands like /effort never reset it.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Hover a pasted [Image #N] to see the picture, above the prompt while you write and on the prompts you sent; in a window by the pointer or drawn in the terminal.

plugins.name: queue
plugins.description: A real prompt queue: Enter while Claude works queues the prompt instead of steering the running turn, and it is sent when the turn ends. Send now, edit or cancel each one from a band above the prompt.
